gaps: Policy names no tool or procedure for fetching transactions (which account/card/deposit to query, whether to ask the customer which product, or list all linked products first).
'Recent' is undefined: no default time window, number of transactions, or date range relative to the simulation date 2026-07-16.
No guidance on filtering or searching (by amount, merchant, type, debit/credit, date) or on pagination/sorting order when there are many results.
Unspecified how to present results: fields shown, formatting, masking of account/card numbers, how many to list, whether to summarize.

Edge cases not covered: customer asks about an unlinked or another person's account (refuse is stated, but how to handle ambiguity), no transactions found, tool errors, pending vs. posted transactions.
Disputed or unrecognized transactions: policy does not say whether to proceed to a dispute, raise a service request, freeze/block a card, or escalate, nor in what order.
Customer may ask follow-ups such as balance, statement download, or fees/charges explanations, so it is unclear when to use the knowledge base versus transaction tools.
Unspecified whether the customer should be asked clarifying questions or the agent should proactively fetch with defaults.
Bank conventions for categorizing or labeling transactions (merchant descriptors, internal codes) and how to explain them without exposing internal field names.
